description: The holon-coherence planner prompt template has no instruction to write a '## Touch Set' section, so plans written for holon-coherence record no touch set and Stage 3 admission refuses every flow on that repository (the plan row records no touch set).
goal: Add to holon-config/prompts/planner.template.md of holon-coherence the touch set instruction and plan format section used by the sibling repository's planner template: the plan lists its touch set at module granularity in a '## Touch Set' section placed after the plan description and strategy section, one backticked repository-relative path per top-level bullet, leaving out plans/, executions/ and holon-knowledge/, and writing '- none' when the plan changes no other file; and add the '## Touch Set' block with a '{repository_relative_path_or_glob}' placeholder to the plan format example. Keep every existing placeholder and section intact. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Without a touch set in the plan, admission cannot compare flows and refuses to run any holon-coherence flow.
acceptance_criteria: A test in tests/test_planner_template_touch_set.py reads holon-config/prompts/planner.template.md and asserts it instructs the planner to write a '## Touch Set' section after the plan description and strategy section, lists plans/, executions/ and holon-knowledge/ as excluded, and has a '## Touch Set' block in the plan format example.

The same test file asserts every placeholder present in holon-config/prompts/planner.template.md before this change is still present and the file still renders with the planner's existing format call.
The coherence planner template asks the planner for a `## Touch Set` section listing files only, using the same wording as the holon-agentic-coder template.
A coherence plan generated from the template records a non-null touch set.
A test in holon-coherence fails when the `## Touch Set` section is missing from the template.
Stage 3 admission admits a coherence plan that carries a touch set, with no "plan has no ## Touch Set section" refusal.
Self-explaining code invariant holds: no docstrings, and the only comments are `# why:` comments.
The project's pytest and lint tasks pass.
